parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description: The username of the account you want to create.

parameters.name: DrdsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the PolarDB-X 1.0 instance for which you want to create the account.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password of the account you want to create.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds create-instance-account --drds-instance-id drdsjiii1b490000 --account-name drds_sample_account --password drds_sample_password --db-privilege DbName=test123 Privilege=DDL --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds CreateInstanceAccount --region cn-hangzhou --DbPrivilege.1.DbName test123 --DrdsInstanceId drdsjiii1b490000 --DbPrivilege.1.Privilege DDL --AccountName drds_sample_account --Password drds_sample_password
